primary_sources.role: official H I measurement and public moment-map release
published centers, inclinations, position angles, velocity-field construction, and kinematic limitations

score_contract.common_mask: finite MOM1 and positive finite MOM2 intersected with the fixed four-model numerical and source eligibility for that source-resolution cell
score_contract.mixed_signal_rule: RG wins at least two primary objects or has smaller equal-object mean primary RMSE than Newton
score_contract.primary_metric: unweighted common-pixel velocity RMSE using the object-resolution shared sign and systemic velocity
score_contract.rotation_sign: one observed major-axis covariance sign per object and resolution computed on that object's fixed-ML nuisance-reference-cell common mask and shared by all candidates and source conversions for that object-resolution
score_contract.shared_systemic_velocity: one observed MOM1 mean per object and resolution computed on that object's nuisance-reference-cell common mask and shared by all candidates and source conversions for that object-resolution
score_contract.strong_external_replication_rule: RG has strictly smaller primary-cell RMSE than Newton, RAR, and standard MOND in at least four of six objects, has the smallest equal-object mean primary RMSE, and wins at least one primary object in every LOW, INTERMEDIATE, and HIGH inclination stratum
